g.text: TDK Workflow v4 - Constitution to Retro
Baseline TDK lifecycle from project authority to feature build, memory sync, and approved retrospective learning
ROUTING BRIDGE - plan assigns work, implement executes it
Quality gates optional. HLD/task breakdown require Unresolved Questions = None. Promoted work-items become child specs.
UT path: /tdk-plan may add Unit Test Planning -> /tdk-ut-backfill-plan -> UT phase files carry the routed consumer test skill.
memory deltas never edit memory directly
reviews, phase drift, UT failures, routing gaps, memory sync, Langfuse optional, UF-### feedback
Critical boundaries: discovery is context-only; spec owns requirement IDs; HLD enriches but does not mint requirements; task breakdown is tracker-neutral; retro apply requires user
memory touchpoints: specify / clarify / analyze are non-
